newsitem.title: UK: ICI and Zeneca extendMSAS air deal.
newsitem.headline: ICI and Zeneca extendMSAS air deal.

text.p: Britain's Imperial Chemical Industries Plc and Zeneca Group Plc have agreed to extend an agreement with MSAS Cargo International Ltd for air freight and associated logistics services, an MSAS news release said.

The contract, started in 1990 and now rolled over into 1997, was generally considered to be one of the biggest airfreight deals in Britain, involving 6,000 tonnes, and covered destinations worldwide, it said.
The release gave no details of the financial terms of the contract.
MSAS UK's director in charge of corporate accounts, David Williams, was quoted as saying that MSAS planned to work closer with ICI and Zeneca over the next 12 months.
ICI and Zeneca cargoes can be anything from heavy bulk consignments to small delicate packs of drugs.
MSAS is a subsidiary of Ocean Group Plc, the international logistics, marine and environmental services group. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
